response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.fundflux, c.cnt AS count, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share, c.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS above_average FROM c, t WHERE c.cnt > t.avg_cnt ORDER BY c.cnt DESC
